Business Requirement
Site Category selected on the on the site is not working as per selection
Business RequirementGRN should be allowed as per mapped category in site.Solution As per current system functionality the category control on the site is only handle on the mentioned receipt type ASN (Advance Shipment Notice) from supplier- Against PO.We need to provide the same functionality on mentioned receipt type.Order Input Return
Against PO.ASN from supplier- Against ASN.ASN from supplier- Against GDN.Alteration Output.Alteration Output
Against GIN.Alteration Input.Alteration Input
Against GIN.Enter New Store transection will be based on the category tagged in the site.This functionality will be governed by setting
Allow GRN based on the Category mapped in the respective site.
Improvement in GRN Development ID: 256707
